name: lyric-writing
description: 18 skills in six layers, with the language layer as the trunk: workflow and the LYR-SPEC contract; general craft (intent gate, structure, imagery, rhyme, narrative); four language layers that are genuinely different methods rather than different tables (Mandarin tone and the thirteen rhyme classes, Cantonese where the writing order reverses, English stress-to-beat, Japanese mora and 符割り); tradition layers (Chinese-style, musical theatre, rap); execution (tone-melody check, backend compile, AI-tell audit); and a case layer. Bidirectionally coupled to the arrangement library. Plain text, no tooling required; answers in the language you ask in
